home.meta.title: Next Tuesday Society
home.meta.description: Arts and philosophy association based in Geneva, conspiring futures into existence, day and night, and especially next Tuesday. Raves, poetry and transcendence.
home.threshold.title: Next Tuesday Society
home.threshold.whisper: Arts and philosophy for the post-history
home.threshold.secret: Hey you, seeker, riding chaos, come next Tuesday. We'll conspire.
home.tuesdays.label: Tuesdays
home.tuesdays.lead: Yes. We gather every Tuesday, of all days, and in Geneva, of all places. It has been so for years and years.
home.tuesdays.body1: It is a ritual. A simple one. Just show up. Share a meal. Share a story. Share a dream. Find the others.
home.tuesdays.body2: We expect you. And you'll be most welcome.
home.tuesdays.whisper.a: The place is whispered on the day. Ask us.
home.philo.label: NOT NOT PHILO
home.philo.lead: Discussions on everything, nothing and anything in between.
home.philo.body: An intimate philo salon, where short provocations become a whole room thinking out loud together.
home.embers.label: EMBERS
home.embers.lead: The floor ain't gonna dance itself.
home.embers.body: Our nightlife series. Raves around Geneva since 2021.
home.field.label: An endless field of possibilities
home.field.body1: And then there is everything else. A crossroad of mystical traditions, embodied practices, hacker culture, speculative realism, art and philosophy, at the fringes of a society that is yet to come.
home.field.body2: INTERSECT, an assembly at the Chaos Communication Congress, is one of the paths through it.
home.words.label: Words DO hold power.
home.words.body1: We are an association in Geneva with two aims: consolidating what already exists and enabling new opportunities.
home.words.body2: Venues, institutions, collaborators: if there is something you would like to make with us, write to us.
home.words.link: What we've done, and what comes next
home.events.label: Yet to come

embers.meta.title: EMBERS · Next Tuesday Society
embers.meta.description: EMBERS is the nightlife series of Next Tuesday Society. Raves around Geneva since 2021, from dirty downtempo to hi-tech.
embers.og.description: Children of the night! Raves around Geneva since 2021. The floor ain't gonna dance itself.
embers.title: EMBERS
embers.lede: The floor ain't gonna dance itself.
embers.body1: We have been throwing raves around Geneva since 2021, and every November the night calls us back.
embers.body2: In January 2025, EMBERS the RAVE took over Sonic Meteor, from 10pm to 6am, with about 300 people on the floor.
embers.body3: From Dirty Downtempo to Hi-Tech and everything that lurks in between.
embers.body4: A journey through exquisite soundscapes and delirious beats for you to let go.
embers.body5: The crowd comes ready to sweat, expressive dancers among them, the kind that get a whole floor moving.
embers.body6: Every night so far has been prix libre: pay what you want.
embers.summon: Children of the night! Listen to these words. They summon you to dance in trance.
embers.venues.label: For venues
embers.venues.body1: You bring the room and the sound. We bring the people, and the fire.

philo.meta.description: A philo salon in Geneva. Discussions on everything, nothing and anything in between, in English and French. No prior knowledge required.
philo.og.description: Discussions on everything, nothing and anything in between. A philo salon by Next Tuesday Society, in Geneva.

philo.title: NOT NOT PHILO
philo.tagline: A series of discussions on everything, nothing and anything in between.
philo.salon.label: Philo salon
philo.salon.body1: The philo salon format is an intimate space for collective inquiry and shared reflection. The event unfolds through short provocations and evolving constellations of dialogue, giving each voice space to find its place in the flow of conversation. In the background, a low hum of music and soft surroundings hold us in the rhythm of thinking together.
philo.salon.body2: No prior knowledge required, only curiosity, a willingness to think out loud and a spirit of respectful engagement.
philo.salon.body3: Conversations move between English and French.
philo.volumes.label: The volumes so far
philo.vol1.title: Do-ocracy
philo.vol1.q: What happens when doing becomes the way we decide?
philo.vol1.line: A mode of organization rooted in open-source communities, hackerspaces, and the Burning Man scene where initiative itself grants authority.
philo.vol2.title: The Power of Fictions
philo.vol2.q: How do certain stories come to define the reality we inhabit?
philo.vol2.line: Building worlds in an age of collapse one story at a time. Who gets to write and circulate them in the age of AI?
philo.vol3.title: The Limits of Language
philo.vol3.q: Whereof one cannot speak, thereof one must be silent?
philo.vol3.line: Or does understanding sometimes begin precisely where language falls silent?
philo.venue: All three at La Galerie, Rue de l'Industrie 13, 1201 Geneva.
philo.next.label: Next
philo.next.title: Next volume: ...
philo.next.body1: The question is still ripening. Follow @next.tuesday.society to hear it first.
philo.next.body2: Bring a question, or come for someone else's.
intersect.meta.title: INTERSECT · Next Tuesday Society
intersect.meta.description: INTERSECT is an assembly at the Chaos Communication Congress, between Christmas and New Year: talks, workshops, conversations and live music.
intersect.og.description: An ancient tradition, a crossroads where humans stop and gather to reflect.
intersect.title: INTERSECT
intersect.lede: An ancient tradition, a crossroads where humans stop and gather to reflect.
intersect.body1: An assembly at the Chaos Communication Congress, the hacker gathering held between Christmas and New Year. Talks, workshops, conversations and live music.
intersect.body2: It is said that those who come leave transformed by each other's perspectives, walking towards shared futures worth materializing.
intersect.body3: The vision: a serious playground for weaving stories of possible futures in times of apocalypse.
intersect.corr.label: A correspondence of worlds
